# Liberty Drum Studio — CC0 factory recordings

The new factory kits bundle source recordings and original drum-machine
one-shots from **Phazite Sounds**, pinned at commit
`bd71faf5035e8aa278ebfe3f4dc68804ae7bc5ca` (2026-10-13).

Source: https://github.com/august-byrne/phazite-sounds
License: https://github.com/august-byrne/phazite-sounds/blob/bd71faf5035e8aa278ebfe3f4dc68804ae7bc5ca/LICENSE.txt
Provenance per recording: https://github.com/august-byrne/phazite-sounds/blob/bd71faf5035e8aa278ebfe3f4dc68804ae7bc5ca/pack/sources.json

All bundled audio material is described by its source project as CC0 1.0
public domain. It includes recorded acoustic hits by Versilian Studios and
Karoryfer Samples, FreePats synthesized percussion, and original Phazite
sounds, among other credited contributors.

The build downloads this pinned, audited source revision at compile time
and embeds a selection of 51 original source files in the Liberty executable
using JUCE BinaryData. The installed application **does not download**
sample assets, and factory kits do not depend on users locating files.

The 10 factory kit maps combine these 51 distinct sources into 160 pad
assignments, with style-dependent tone, gain and transient shaping.
A source may be reused in more than one kit; claiming 160 independently
recorded sources would be inaccurate.

The 100 MIDI rhythms are newly authored Liberty presets, independent of
the Phazite Sounds pack. Original pattern edits are saved to kit/project XML
and exported as normal MIDI arrangement clips.

CC0 applies to the incorporated audio source material, not to Liberty's
proprietary application source code or binary.
